source.note: The "Smoldering." sidebar printed under this spell is a general condition definition, not part of the spell, so it is not in text.

name: Heart’s Fire
text: Range: 4. (1/round) Give an ally 1 action. Cast as a Reaction for 1 mana.

source.note: The (1/round) is printed in the body text, not next to the name, so no limit is set (question for rules owner).

name: Ignite
text: Range: 10. Damage: 4d10 to a Smoldering target.

name: Enchant Weapon
text: Concentration: 1 min. Reach: 8. A weapon you choose inflicts Smoldering on crit and gains (1/turn) +KEY damage.

name: Flame Barrier
text: Castable only while Defending. Reach: 1, AoE. Damage: 10+KEY and Smoldering. Triggers whenever you are attacked this round.

name: Pyroclasm
text: Reach: 3, AoE. Damage: 2d20+10, half on DEX save (Smoldering creatures fail).

name: Fiery Embrace
text: Concentration: 1 min. Reach: 10, AoE. An ally gains the effects of Enchant Weapon. Enemies gain Smoldering, and effects that would end it, don’t.

name: Living Inferno
text: Gain the effects of Flame Barrier until your next turn. At the end of this turn and your next turn, cast Pyroclasm for free.

name: Dragonform
text:
Transform into a Huge dragon. Gain 3 actions, a flying Speed of 12, LVL Defense, 10×LVL temp HP, and:
• Tooth & Claw. 1 Action: (Reach 2) 1d20+LVL damage (ignoring armor). Inflicts Smoldering.
• Immolating Breath. 2 Actions: (Cone 10, AoE) KEY d20 damage, half on DEX save (Smoldering targets fail).
Note. You can maintain this form for as long as the temp HP granted by this spell remain (max. 10 min). When it ends, you drop to 0 HP.

source.note: Printed cost is 5 Actions, but the schema allows actions 0-3, so it is stored as castingTime "5 Actions" (schema question). "Note." is a sidebar box printed under the spell; appended to text. The Tooth & Claw (1d20+LVL) and Immolating Breath (KEY d20, half on DEX save) rolls are not encoded because a spell has a single roll.

name: Firebrand
text: Touch a surface and secretly mark it with a symbol or brief message. Speaking a chosen command word while nearby reveals it.

name: Fire Step
text: Teleport to a fire source you can see.

name: Kindle
text: Conjure a minor visual illusion. OR: Ignite a small, unheld item within Reach 6.
